evidence_origin: Owner-supplied Markdown report from a local Windows desktop Codex GPT-5.6 test; this review did not operate or independently observe the VM.

candidate.source_binding_basis: The report's ISO digest matches the independently reviewed normal-image provenance and qualification run for this source; the report itself does not supply a source commit.

vm_configuration_reported.host_context: Windows 11 Home, supplied by the owner in the preceding field observation; Windows edition/build is not independently established by this report.
vm_configuration_reported.secure_boot: off/unavailable; no enrolled platform key reported

results_reported.graphical_greeter: pass; subsequently exercised after terminating the current session and switching to tty1
results_reported.wayland_session: pass; greetd and online Wayland session reported
results_reported.phishell: pass; displayed and interactive window launched
results_reported.waybar: pass; interface, CPU, memory and clock modules populated
results_reported.cursor_functional: pass; VirtualBox absolute pointer injection visibly moved the guest-rendered cursor to (100,100), then (900,200) after a cold boot
results_reported.system_manager_failed_units: 0 loaded units reported by systemctl --failed; no separate user-manager failed-unit output supplied
results_reported.cold_power_cycle: pass; ACPI power button reached VMState=poweroff, followed by cold start with PhiShell, Waybar and working cursor

preserved_observations.reported_result: blank screen rather than a visible lock UI
preserved_observations.subsequent_action_reported: terminate current login session and switch to tty1; graphical greeter and phios/phios authentication passed
preserved_observations.assessment: Unresolved lock-screen appearance/authentication observation. The packaged locker uses a dark solid background without requesting an idle-visible indicator; that is consistent with a blank idle screen but does not demonstrate successful locking, wrong-password refusal or unlock in this VM. Greeter authentication after session termination does not replace those tests.

preserved_observations.reported_result: refused; the live phios user is not allowed to execute /usr/bin/poweroff as root
preserved_observations.subsequent_action_reported: VM ACPI power button successfully completed shutdown and cold restart
preserved_observations.assessment: Preserved live-account administration refusal; no sudo/logind/PolicyKit permission was expanded, and this report does not test the documented guest systemctl poweroff path.

preserved_observations.reported_result: Secure Boot unavailable because no platform key is enrolled
preserved_observations.subsequent_action_reported: VM restarted and returned to a healthy graphical session
preserved_observations.assessment: Effective Secure Boot off reported; no platform key enrollment or Secure Boot support is qualified.

scope: Reported VirtualBox normal live-ISO boot, graphical greeter/login, automatic cursor/session startup, pointer interaction and cold power cycle on the exact supplied ISO only.
not_qualified_by_this_field_report: VirtualBox lock, wrong-password refusal and PAM unlock
VirtualBox installation, disk-only boot, durable data and recovery
VirtualBox guest systemctl shutdown permission path
audio playback/capture, network connectivity or suspend/resume
other VirtualBox versions or graphics configurations
physical Skytech/RTX 5070 compatibility or physical installation
actual maintainer-signed transition or source/license delivery review
